content.title: Watch live sports on Disney+
content.text: Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Bundle subscribers and Disney+ subscribers with a standalone ESPN subscription* have access to the top sporting events and leagues from ESPN in the Disney+ app. From college football to hockey and everything in between, ESPN on Disney+ has sports for everyone! NOTE: If you are a Disney+, Hulu, Max Bundle subscriber, you can add the ESPN Unlimited Add-on to your plan and watch ESPN on Disney+. If you have the ESPN Unlimited plan through a participating TV provider, you can access ESPN Unlimited content on Disney+ after you activate your subscription. *If you don’t have access to an ESPN subscription – through a bundle, add-on, or standalone subscription – only a sampling of ESPN sports content will be available to you as a Disney+ subscriber. Select one of the following questions to learn more about watching live sports on Disney+: How do I watch live sports on Disney+?What sports content is available with ESPN Select and ESPN Unlimited?Where do I find sporting events on Disney+?What other sports content is available with ESPN on Disney+?Do blackout restrictions apply on ESPN on Disney+?Can I sign up for NFL+ Premium on Disney+? How do I watch live sports on Disney+? To see which sports are currently live and view upcoming events, select the ESPN icon on the navigation bar at the top of the homepage. You can also visit the Live hub on living room devices and web browsers by selecting the lightning icon on the left of the screen. Keep in mind that only subscribers with both Disney+ and an ESPN subscription will have access to a slate of events, replays, and on-demand content from ESPN. Disney+ subscribers with an ESPN Unlimited subscription will also have access to all of ESPN’s networks and services – including ESPN and ESPN2, among others — through the ESPN tile or the Disney+ app homepage. If you do not have an ESPN subscription, you will still have access to a sampling of ESPN sports content. Additionally, Disney+ subscribers will have exclusive access to SC+, a daily SportsCenter show, and Vibe Check, a female-led sports show airing three times a week. To learn more about upcoming live events and other new content on Disney+, visit Explore Disney+. BACK TO TOP What sports content is available with ESPN Select or ESPN Unlimited? ESPN Select ContentESPN Unlimited content ESPN Select content An ESPN Select subscription gives you access to all content from the ESPN+ library. Here’s a preview of some of the sports content you can find on Disney+ with a Disney+ and ESPN Select subscription: NHLPGA TOUR LIVEGrand Slam tennisCollege sports (including football, basketball, baseball, soccer, volleyball, gymnastics, and more from top conferences including Big 12, SEC, ACC, and The American)International soccer leagues and tournaments (including LALIGA, Bundesliga, FA Cup, and Carabao Cup)The complete 30 for 30 library Please note that not every event from these leagues will be included in your subscription(s), and some events may be subject to regional blackouts based on your location. ESPN Unlimited content ESPN Unlimited includes all ESPN Select content, plus all ESPN networks and services including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPN+, ESPN on ABC, SEC Network+, ACC Network Extra, and ESPN3. Here’s a preview of some of the sports content you can find on Disney+ with a linked Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited subscription: College football games and the College Football Playoffs NFLNBA and WNBAFormula 1Wimbledon, US Open, Australian OpenThe MastersSportsCenterFirst TakeGet UpCollege GameDayWWE Please note that not every event from these leagues will be included in your subscription(s), and some events may be subject to regional blackouts based on your location. BACK TO TOP Where do I find sporting events on Disney+? To watch live ESPN events and see which events are airing next, select the ESPN icon on the navigation bar at the top of the homepage. You can also visit the Live hub on living room devices and web browsers by selecting the lightning icon on the left of the screen. You can also add live sporting events to your Watchlist. Once you’re navigating your Watchlist, check out the My Live & Upcoming row to view and manage your favorite events and leagues. You can even catch top live sporting events from the Disney+ homepage. If you miss a live event, you can also stream replays of most live events from the ESPN hub. If you added the live event to your Watchlist, you can also access the replay of that event from your Watchlist directly. Keep in mind that to have access to a wider slate of ESPN content on Disney+, you will need a standalone ESPN subscription in addition to your Disney+ account, or a subscription to a Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Bundle plan. BACK TO TOP What other sports content is available with ESPN on Disney+? The sports experience doesn’t end with the game — as a true fan, you’ll want to check out what the experts have to say. ESPN Select and ESPN Unlimited subscription plans both give you access to a variety of studio shows and original content on Disney+. Keep in mind that only subscribers with both Disney+ and an ESPN subscription will have access to this ESPN content on Disney+. Some of the titles available with ESPN on Disney+ are: Man in the Arena: Tom BradyThe Pat McAfee ShowPeyton’s Places with Peyton ManningEli’s Places with Eli ManningESPN FC — Daily highlights & analysis of the best leagues in the worldThe Ultimate FighterThe complete award-winning 30 for 30 library, and much more Subscribers with access to ESPN Unlimited will have access to the most ESPN content – including College GameDay, First Take, and SportsCenter for all your pregame and postgame needs. If you do not have an ESPN subscription, you will still have access to a sampling of ESPN sports content on Disney+ – including Spanish-language feeds of UEFA Women's Champions League matches. Additionally, Disney+ subscribers will have exclusive access to SC+, a daily SportsCenter show, and Vibe Check, a female-led sports show airing three times a week. BACK TO TOP Do blackout restrictions apply to ESPN content on Disney+? ESPN on Disney+ offers access to certain out-of-market games from notable leagues — including the NHL.** However, live sporting events and other content available through ESPN may be subject to blackouts if a participating team is considered in-market for your location. For example, if you're trying to watch a game that includes an in-market team — even if the game is nationally televised — the game may be blacked out for streaming on ESPN (or other applicable third-party services). Blackouts are determined by the various sports leagues and teams and will be enforced according to the location from which you are accessing the content. You must enable location services to access ESPN content on Disney+. For more details on NHL blackouts — including which teams may be considered in-market in your area — please visit the blackout page for that league. If you’re unable to watch a game you believe you should have access to, please contact ESPN Fan Support for further assistance. **Access to out-of-market NHL games requires any standalone ESPN subscription or a subscription to a Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Bundle plan. BACK TO TOP Can I sign up for NFL+ Premium on Disney+? Yes, eligible Disney+ subscribers can purchase NFL+ Premium through their Account Page. NFL+ Premium is only available through Disney+ to Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle subscribers or Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle subscribers with an ESPN Unlimited Add-on. Additionally, subscribers will need to be billed directly by Disney+ or ESPN to purchase NFL+ Premium. If you subscribe to an eligible bundle through Hulu, you will not be able to purchase NFL+ Premium at this time. Keep in mind the NFL+ Premium content is only available on the NFL app and cannot be streamed on the Disney+, Hulu, or ESPN apps. For more information on NFL+ content, please visit NFL Support. BACK TO TOP
